title: Address Object

visibility.title: address visibility
visibility.description: Full address, street name or zone will be shown publicly

streetKilometer.title: address street kilometer
streetKilometer.description: It will only by displayed for Lands typologies

floor.title: address floor
floor.description: bj: ground floor, en: mezzanine floor, ss: semi-basement, st: basement

urbanization.title: address urbanization
urbanization.description: This field will be shown even if the visibility is set to 'hidden'

nsiCode.title: address nsi code
nsiCode.description: National institute of statistics town code. Only available for Italy

casaZoneId.title: address casa zone id
casaZoneId.description: Only available for Italy.  It will be sent to Casa.it only to specify the zone

country.title: address country
country.description:
* Andorra can only be sent for idealista.com
* France can be sent also for idealista.com and idealista.it in the following regions:
 * for idealista.com only País Vasco Francés and Cerdanya Francesa areas are allowed
 * for idealista.it only Alpi Marittime-Costa Azzurra area is allowed
* Switzerland can only be sent for idealista.it and idealista.fr, and only Canton Ticino area is allowed for idealista.it
* San Marino can only be sent for idealista.it
* Monaco, Luxembourg and Belgium can only be sent for idealista.fr

precision.title: address coordinates precision
precision.description: If moved, just the property zone will be shown publicly, but not its address

latitude.title: address coordinates latitude
latitude.description: To have a good accuracy, latitude need to have at least 4 decimals

longitude.title: address coordinates longitude
longitude.description: To have a good accuracy, longitude need to have at least 4 decimals

description: The option of (addressPostalCode, addressCountry) is only available for Portugal. If you send only coordinates we will not publish with exact visibility, maximum with street only visibility. If the number of the address is not sent the visibility will never be complete and show only street visibility without number.
